name: money-surfaces-visual
description: Redesign P5: Contracts, Finances, and Operations panels rendered with real state — a blasted plan (spend + fragments + logistics), one negotiated offer, one accepted contract, and a shift-policy change. Plan origin (5,5), not (10,10): see blast-workshop-french-visual.json's own note on the pre-existing (10,10)-seed-42 terrain-remesh crash this sidesteps. Setup split so the blast pipeline steps are individually role-marked and clicked for real (issue #479); the multi-offer contract targeting stays a command (see step description) because offer rows have no id-scoped selector.

steps.command: drill_plan grid origin:5,5 rows:2 cols:2 spacing:3 depth:6
steps.description: Split out of the original bundled setup step (issue #479). This grid's spacing:3 already matches the placement strip's default (DEFAULT_SPACING_M, Drill.ts) — unlike blast-drill-plan-ui.json/blast-drill-plan-visual.json (Finding #4), no stepper clicks are needed for the click to reach the declared 2x2 pattern.

expect.note: a fired blast clears the plan back to zero; confirmed against the real dump — cash does not change here (charge/blast spend is not reflected in the serialized cash field for this pipeline, unlike a building/vehicle purchase)

steps.description: #513 fix landed: offered-contract cards now carry `data-contract-id`, so negotiating contract 1 and accepting contract 2 specifically is a reliable, scoped click instead of only ever reaching "the first offer". Converted from three commands to real clicks: open the contracts panel, negotiate on card 1's own `[data-action="negotiate"]`, then accept on card 2's own `.bs-contract-accept`.
Contracts panel: storage strip, one active card, offered cards with the negotiate result inline on #1

expect.note: 'blocked' here is used for presence, not the usual guard-proof: a Deliver row only renders on an ACCEPTED contract's card (offered cards show Accept/Negotiate/Decline instead), so its presence proves id:2 actually got accepted. It's disabled (confirmed via a real interaction-mode run), since nothing has been hauled to storage yet to deliver — that's why 'blocked' (present, not reachable) is correct here rather than 'usable'.

steps.description: Finances panel: real balance/trend/runway, category bars from the blast spend, ledger — opened via the TopBar balance click, not a rail button

expect.note: toolbar panels are mutually exclusive — opening Finances via the TopBar balance click must hide Contracts

steps.description: Operations panel: logistics rows from the blast's fragments, empty ore-on-hand/incidents states, site policy card

expect.note: the Apply control the next step clicks must already be usable once this panel is open

steps.description: Operations panel: clicking a shift pill and Apply is a real, clickable interaction — pill highlight updates, note text changes, Apply dispatches set_policy
